llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及的是高熵合金的增材制造，而非生物医用植入物材料的力学性能、疲劳或骨整合研究。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address any biomedical implant context, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration, focusing instead on the microstructure and strengthening mechanisms of a non-biomedical alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备的CoCrFeNiMn高熵合金的微观结构与强化机制。
summary_zh.method: 利用SLM技术制备合金，通过表征分析微观结构并与力学性能关联。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了SLM工艺下高熵合金的层级微观结构及其对强度的贡献。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试验证强化模型。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the hierarchical microstructure and strengthening mechanisms of a CoCrFeNiMn high entropy alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: The alloy was produced via SLM and characterized using electron microscopy and mechanical testing to correlate microstructure with properties.
summary_en.result: A hierarchical microstructure was observed, contributing to high strength through multiple strengthening mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile tests) validated the strengthening models.

papers.title: Automated Femoral Stem Canal Fill Ratio Evaluation for Bipolar Hip Arthroplasty in 2D X-Ray Image
papers.abstract: A stem loosening is one of the significant problem in the bipolar hip arthroplasty (BHA), causes a pain and instability of a patient’s hip, and requires a further surgery of BHA. A stem canal fill ratio (SCFR), a general evaluation of the stem loosening, have been clinically studied many; however, a determination of the optimal SCFR evaluation has not been still understood well. A purpose of this study is to propose an automatic and quantitative evaluation of SCFR from BHA hip X-ray image. A proposed method segmented the femoral canal and stem, and evaluated SCFR. In experiments, a proposed method’s accuracy was validated, and six BHA patients’ SCFRs were clinically evaluated (age 88±7 (74–93), one male / five females). In result of the proposed method’s accuracy, the femur canal was 90.60±3.65%, and the stem was 97.83±0.46%; therefore, the proposed method had the accuracy to well evaluate SCFR. Result of six BHA patients’ SCFRs was 63.70±5.62%. In conclusion, the proposed method was able to automatically evaluate SCFR from the hip X-ray image with BHA.
papers.venue: Journal of Advanced Computational Intelligence and Intelligent Informatics

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注X光图像中股骨柄填充比的自动评估，未涉及应力遮挡或微动的力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion, does not involve finite element modeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出自动评估髋关节置换术后股骨柄填充比的方法。
summary_zh.method: 从X光图像中分割股骨髓腔和假体，计算填充比。
summary_zh.result: 分割精度高，六例患者填充比平均63.70%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过真实患者X光图像验证分割精度。

summary_en.motivation: To automate the evaluation of stem canal fill ratio from hip X-ray images for assessing stem loosening.
summary_en.method: The method segments the femoral canal and stem in X-ray images to compute the fill ratio.
summary_en.result: Segmentation accuracy reached 90.6% for canal and 97.8% for stem; six patient fill ratios averaged 63.70%.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed on clinical X-ray images of six patients with accuracy metrics.
